title: Concept: Predictable generator via val rng = Random() (kotlin) — review required
description: In kotlin, val rng = Random() creates a general-purpose generator seeded from the clock. The sequence is deterministic once the seed or a few outputs are known, so passwords, session identifiers and one-time codes derived from it can be predicted. Draw security values from SecureRandom.
applicability: kotlin code that mints tokens, codes or salts; lexical scope.
